methodology.rank: One-based position returned by GitHub Contributors API; lower is better. Null means unavailable, not zero.
methodology.observation_time: Historical Git commit timestamp records when a snapshot was saved, not the exact instant GitHub rank changed. New refreshes use the time the source snapshot was saved/synced in UTC; this does not assert a fresh API collection.
methodology.coverage: Only saved observations are shown. Missing repository entries are unknown. Consecutive equal ranks retain their first and latest observations.
methodology.baseline: first_merged_at is the earliest authored merged pull request in the available accepted-activity receipts; it is not necessarily the first commit or contribution.
methodology.top5: first_top5_at is the first saved rank 1–5. If the first known rank is already top five, top5_left_censored is true and exact climb duration is unknown.
methodology.duration: days_to_top5 measures elapsed days from first_merged_at to first observed top-five snapshot only when a preceding known rank above five exists. It is an observed bound, not an exact crossing time.
methodology.history_sources: Profile origin/main snapshots extend coverage before the first website snapshot; website snapshots are authoritative thereafter, avoiding delayed copies being counted as new rank changes.
